SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Basketball OR BELL BASKETBALL ● Dribbling - crossover ● Faking and Feinting ● Shooting -Set shot -Lay-up shot -Jump shot, part of Games in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 PHYSICAL EDUCATION FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why should a learner use different dribbling skills in Basketball game or Bell Basketball?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
12

• Digital Literacy: The learner uses digital devices to search and observe videos on the skills used in Basketball or Bell

Basketball.

• Self-efficacy: The learner demonstrates confidence while dribbling and dodging opponents during mini games of

Basketball or Bell Basketball.

• Citizenship: The learner shows respect for others while playing Basketball or Bell Basketball.

Values:
• Social justice: The learner demonstrates fair play, observing rules during Basketball or Bell Basketball games.

• Unity: The learner collaborates with others while playing mini Basketball or Bell Basketball games.

• Peace: The learner avoids hurting others while playing Basketball or Bell Basketball.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Self-esteem: The learner perfects and executes dribbling and dodging in Basketball or Bell Basketball.

• Safety and Security: The learner embraces sportsmanship and fair play while playing Basketball or Bell Basketball.

17

• Integrity: The learner demonstrates honesty, fairness, and ethical behaviour while playing a Badminton or Blind

Badminton game.

• Peace: The learner exhibits composure and control while practising strokes in Badminton or Blind Badminton with

peers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues (PCI
s) :

feedback while participating in a Badminton game or Blind Badminton.

• Healthy lifestyle: The learner improves their physical fitness and overall well-being while playing the Badminton or

Blind Badminton game.
